messages:
maria: quick sanity check  saw a customer report where the Console is rendering raw schema errors from fncalls (includes parts of user prompt). Not ideal, likely PII leak risk :eyes:

dave: can you paste an example?

maria: pasted below (redacted). this is what the console shows under 'validation' for the last 3 rejects:
```json
{
  "error": "ValidationError",
  "path": ["response.payment_info.card_number"],
  "message": "expected string matching /\\d{16}/, got "REDACTED_USER_INPUT""
}
```

sasha: ugh  console is just surfacing the raw validator message. We should never display fields named like payment, ssn, email etc.

oliver: is this from the new strict-schema rollout? I thought we redacted errors for public tenants.

maria: it's from the strict fncall validator that went live in canary last week. Canary traffic uses the staging-console pipeline which doesn't have the PII-redaction middleware enabled. Small % of customers hit it.

telemetry-bot: alert: structured-rejects spike for tenant: acme-corp, count: 124 in last 10m (sampled)

dave: So two problems: (1) the UI showing raw error strings, (2) the console ingestion pipeline not stripping sensitive paths before indexing. We need quick mitigation + longterm UX.

oliver: quick mitigation options: 1) hide validation details behind a toggle for non-admins, 2) replace error messages with generic codes, 3) enable redaction in staging-console now. Thoughts?

maria: prefer (3) immediate + (2) as fallback. Redaction lambda can be hotfixed to staging within an hour.

sasha: note on telemetry: we rely on the exact path strings in reject metrics to drive dashboards. Redacting paths will reduce observability. We need a mapping strategy: hashed path tokens + keep counters.

dave: agree. for dashboards, emit sanitized_path (e.g., payment_info.card_number -> payment_info.<sensitive>) and a hashed path id for joinability. Store the raw path only in an access-controlled audit log (retention 7 days).

oliver: UX proposal: console shows a high-level reason and a safe sample of the model output (masked). Advanced view (admin + audit log permission) can show original error but masked tokens and timestamp, and requires confirmation to unmask.

maria: implementation plan:
- hotfix redaction in staging-console (1hr)
- push generic error codes for default view (2d)
- add telemetry fields sanitized_path + path_hash (3d)
- audit-log retention gating + access control (security lead + legal) (1w)

sasha: I'll queue a temporary alert suppression rule for that tenant to avoid pager noise while we fix. cc: @dave for telemetry changes.

dave: I'll open a small RFC for path_hash design and include sample query patterns for the dashboard team. Also add unit tests for not exposing raw user input in error strings.

oliver: can we also add a console banner to affected orgs: "We're addressing a validation display issue that may expose parts of inputs in error details. Temporary access restrictions applied."

maria: yes. I'll draft the banner and comms.

sasha: one more ops note  the fncall validator logs still contain the rejected value. We should ensure logs are redacted at ingestion (not just UI). I'll add a logprocessor rule.

dave: good call. telemetry-bot: please add a tag to the reject spike indicating "potential-pii-exposure" so downstream data-retention jobs treat these records specially.

telemetry-bot: tag applied: potential-pii-exposure

maria: thanks. I'll follow up with a timeline and will post the hotfix PR link here once ready. :thumbsup:

oliver: thanks team  prioritize security and low-friction UX for rollouts.

maria: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/console/merge/1234 (hotfix redaction)

sasha: verified staging redaction on a sample replay. console no longer shows raw input. will monitor.

maria: closing loop  will open a retro ticket to ensure canary consoles always mirror prod redaction rules.

dave: nice. follow-up item: add telemetry sampling note to RFC so path_hash can be used to correlate with evals without leaking data.

oliver: great thread.
